title: Existence of one normalized integral reduction presentation
statement: Fix l, E, Y, D, hl and a TensorPresentation a as in lem-sf-integral-hom-models-exist. For each fixed n there is a ReductionPresentation from a at level n.

proof.text: First construct a finite-level target TensorPresentation by the same K-flat tensor-Hom construction over the quotient coefficient sheaf. Then, for that target, construct the normalized derived comparison and its sectionwise counit square by scalar extension and restriction. The combining theorem packages the target and the normalization witness into ReductionPresentation.
